transport: two loopback SSH endpoints, one kernel
checks: w initializes SSH outside the editor; C shows two retained idle workers
Inventory marking and parallel execution reuse both warmed worker PIDs on real SSH endpoints
RET, a and d open separate, combined and digest result buffers
Explicit remote completion opt-in; M-TAB shows host-specific candidates in Org and C-c ' source editor
C-c C-c preserves Org execution confirmation
Serial Org execution preserves db-01 then web-01 order
Combined and table renderers insert results into the originating Org block
A real remote exit 7 remains failed, with separate stderr

snapshots.label: runbook before execution
snapshots.text:
#+title: Operations runbook · isolated SSH lab
#+startup: showall

* Serial health check
Run db-01 first; wait for completion before starting web-01.

#+begin_src sh :hosts db-01 web-01 :concurrency 1 :renderer combined :results output :timeout 20
cat status.txt
sleep 0.5
printf 'check completed\n'
#+end_src

* Intentional failure
The database fixture returns exit 7; the web fixture succeeds.

#+begin_src sh :hosts @lab :concurrency 2 :renderer table :results output :timeout 20
if grep -q 'role=db' status.txt; then
  printf 'database check failed\n' >&2
  exit 7
fi
printf 'web check passed\n'
#+end_src
